description: This Utrecht University Figshare deposit harmonises climate loss-and-damage indicators for 267 countries and territories. The research team brings together 60 fields covering recorded losses, hazard exposure, vulnerability, adaptation readiness, attribution studies, finance and governance. Version 3 includes CSV data, R Markdown processing code and source documentation, published in November 2021. It is publicly available without a fee under CC-BY-SA-4.0. The national indicators can provide context for infrastructure-resilience scenarios and cross-country comparisons and complement data-em-dat. Source periods and country definitions vary, and some fields cover only a subset of countries. Population or GDP normalisation does not remove differences in reporting. Non-economic losses and local infrastructure conditions remain incompletely represented, so these aggregate indicators cannot substitute for asset-level exposure or fragility data.
